messages.author: e28c6f16c9d07e24
messages.subject: line type inconsistency
parts:
I am building a shiny app, and I get differences in the way plots look on local computer versus shinyapps.io. I've attached two screenshots of the same graph from the same shiny app. One is residing on shinyapps.io, and the other on my computer. Notice that the line types are different. On the shinyapps.io version, the dashes and dots are bunched up so tightly one can't tell the difference between them. Does this have something to to with the point size? How can I change it?

The app is https://richarddmorey.shinyapps.io/confidenceFallacy.

Richard

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: line type inconsistency
parts:
Can you try adding this line to the top of server.R?

options(shiny.usecairo=FALSE)

Shiny will use Cairo automatically if it's available. Usually this results in higher quality output, but sometimes the reverse is true.
